Record the simulator screen.

```sh
proof video <subcommand>
```

**Subcommands:** [`start`](#proof-video-start) · [`stop`](#proof-video-stop)

## proof video start

```sh
proof video start [--json] [--max-lines <max-lines>] [<name>]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--max-lines <max-lines>` | Cut text output to this many lines; the rest goes to ~/.proof/last-output.txt. Also PROOF_MAX_LINES. |
| `<name>` | Default: `session`. |

**JSON output** (`--json`):

- [`MessageReport`](../../json-output/#messagereport)

## proof video stop

```sh
proof video stop [--json] [--max-lines <max-lines>]
```

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--max-lines <max-lines>` | Cut text output to this many lines; the rest goes to ~/.proof/last-output.txt. Also PROOF_MAX_LINES. |

**JSON output** (`--json`):

- [`MessageReport`](../../json-output/#messagereport)
